slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-92 INT32 leaderLineWeight
scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 DXF source with two root-reachable MLEADERSTYLE records. STANDARD has one existing group-92 INT32 leaderLineWeight value 25 and an opaque group-302 tag; SECONDARY is unchanged. Supports a standalone typed leaderLineWeight change from 25 to 50.

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain one existing group-92 INTEGER corresponding to the parsed INT32 leaderLineWeight. leaderLineWeight must be the only changed typed payload field; table-entry identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-92 value in a copy of the captured raw body using the ordinary signed INTEGER variant. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 92, conflicting raw changes, simultaneous DOUBLE or other typed edits, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction. The INTEGER representation is required by the MLEADERSTYLE raw-record validator; the generic BodyWriter's INTEGER64 special case for unsigned MATERIAL values is not reused.
contract.outputAndReadback: Inspect the staged OBJECTS body against every retained raw field and mapped handle, then decode the emitted MLEADERSTYLE and require group-92 leaderLineWeight to equal 50. Fresh readback checks the typed property and one literal group-92 INTEGER value 50. Both source encodings are exercised; output uses same-format and cross-format ASCII/binary paths.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing captured raw group 92 from 25 to 26 while the typed value requests 50 refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. A simultaneous group-45 textHeight edit refuses atomically. A late typed lineweight mutation after preflight also refuses without replacing the destination; restoring the requested value permits same-adapter retry. Exact field and fresh readback checks pass after retry.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep existing raw replay. Transactions are not admitted for other source or target versions, multiple changes on one record, or other integer fields. Typed DWG-origin writing remains unchanged. Test sources and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture is committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits group 92=25 in the AcDbMLeaderStyle subclass with two root dictionary entries, existing typed references, and opaque group-302 tags; ASCII and binary inputs are generated locally from scratch.

focusedSelectors.summary: 2/2 passed. The authored group-92 INT32 profile proves exact output/readback in ASCII/binary same-format and cross-format paths, raw conflict rollback, mixed DOUBLE/INT32 edit refusal, late-mutation rollback, and corrected same-adapter retry.

validation.diffCheck: git diff --check; PASS before implementation commit

limitations: The evidence qualifies one authored AC1027 adapter transaction only. It does not prove independent producer variation, native lineweight meaning or rendering, cross-version support, DWG editing, complete MLEADERSTYLE coverage, consumer acceptance or full document closure.
No support claim is promoted; the support ledger remains closed.
